Semester 6: Advanced Specialties

Read the summary line. If it feels unfamiliar, open the chapter and study the diagram.

Child Health Nursing II

Orthopaedic, Eye, ENT & Skin Disorders

  • Childhood orthopaedic, eye, ENT and skin disorders — club foot, squint, otitis media, conjunctivitis, eczema and scabies.
  • Describe common childhood orthopaedic disorders
  • Give nursing care for eye disorders in children

Mental Health Nursing II

Substance Use Disorders

  • Alcohol, tobacco, opioids and other substance use — dependence, withdrawal, treatment and nursing care.
  • Describe types of substance use disorders
  • Explain dependence and withdrawal

Nursing Management & Leadership

Health Care & Nursing Services in India

  • Health care and nursing services in India — levels, agencies, staffing and the nurse’s role in service delivery.
  • Describe levels of health care
  • Describe the agencies delivering nursing services

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Introduction & Reproductive Health

  • Midwifery in nursing — midwifery, obstetrics, reproductive health and the role of the midwife.
  • Define midwifery and obstetrics
  • Describe reproductive health concepts

Child Health Nursing II

Communicable Diseases in Children

  • Childhood communicable diseases — chickenpox, measles, mumps, pertussis and others, with nursing care and immunisation.
  • Describe the common exanthemata and their incubation
  • Give nursing care for infectious children

Mental Health Nursing II

Personality & Sexual Disorders

  • Personality disorders and sexual disorders — types, recognition, nursing care and non-judgemental support.
  • Describe types of personality disorders
  • Give nursing care for personality disorders

Nursing Management & Leadership

Management Basics for Nurses

  • Management basics for nurses — functions of management, types of managers, decision making and delegation.
  • List the functions of management
  • Differentiate levels of management

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Reproductive Anatomy, Conception & Fetal Development

  • Female reproductive anatomy, menstruation, conception, fertilisation, placenta and fetal development by weeks.
  • Describe the female reproductive organs
  • Explain ovulation, fertilisation and implantation

Child Health Nursing II

Behavioural & Social Problems

  • Childhood behavioural and social problems — enuresis, temper tantrums, aggression, learning problems, ADHD, autism and screen habits.
  • Describe common behavioural problems in children
  • Explain enuresis and its management

Mental Health Nursing II

Childhood & Adolescent Disorders

  • Childhood and adolescent mental disorders — intellectual disability, ADHD, autism, conduct disorder, depression and eating disorders.
  • Describe intellectual disability and its levels
  • Explain ADHD, autism and conduct disorder

Nursing Management & Leadership

Planning Nursing Services

  • Planning nursing services — steps, types, policies and procedures, budget and hospital design.
  • Describe the steps of planning
  • Differentiate policies, procedures and protocols

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Antenatal Care

  • Antenatal care — booking visit, schedule, examination, danger signs, anaemia and immunisation in pregnancy.
  • Describe the antenatal visit schedule
  • Take a booking history and examination

Child Health Nursing II

Care of Challenged Children

  • Care of challenged children — disability types, rehabilitation, family support, special education, adoption and legal protection.
  • Describe types of disability in children
  • Explain the rehabilitation process

Mental Health Nursing II

Organic Brain Disorders

  • Organic brain disorders — dementia, delirium, amnesic syndromes and alcohol-related brain damage.
  • Differentiate delirium and dementia
  • Describe causes and features of dementia

Nursing Management & Leadership

Organising & Hospital Administration

  • Organising the work, hospital administration, departments, organisational structure and the nurse’s place in it.
  • Describe the process of organising
  • Describe the structure of a hospital

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Normal Labour & Intrapartum Care

  • Normal labour — signs, stages, partograph, nursing care during labour and the delivery of the placenta.
  • Recognise the signs of labour
  • Describe the stages of labour

Mental Health Nursing II

Psychiatric Emergencies & Crisis

  • Psychiatric emergencies — suicide, violence, catatonia, serotonin syndrome, NMS and crisis intervention.
  • Recognise common psychiatric emergencies
  • Manage violence and suicidal patients safely

Nursing Management & Leadership

Staffing & Scheduling

  • Staffing and scheduling — estimating nurses, duty roster, shift patterns and management of shortage and leave.
  • Estimate the staffing needs of a unit
  • Plan a duty roster

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Postpartum Care

  • Postpartum care — involution, lochia, breastfeeding, postnatal danger signs and family planning guidance.
  • Describe postpartum changes in the mother
  • Assess involution and lochia

Mental Health Nursing II

Legal Issues & MHCA 2017

  • Legal issues in mental health — the Mental Healthcare Act 2017, admission, discharge, rights, informed consent and the nurse’s role.
  • Describe the Mental Healthcare Act 2017
  • Explain types of mental health admission

Nursing Management & Leadership

Directing & Supervision

  • Directing and supervision — guiding staff, motivation, communication, discipline and supervision rounds.
  • Describe directing in nursing
  • Use supervision effectively

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Care of the Normal Newborn

  • Care of the normal newborn — first minutes, examination, weight loss, immunisation schedule, feeding and hygiene.
  • Describe immediate care after birth
  • Perform a newborn examination

Mental Health Nursing II

Community Mental Health Nursing

  • Community mental health — levels of intervention, outreach, rehabilitation, family burden and stigma reduction.
  • Describe the scope of community mental health nursing
  • Explain outreach and follow-up programmes

Nursing Management & Leadership

Leadership & Change

  • Leadership and change — qualities, styles, power, conflict management and leading change in nursing.
  • Describe qualities of a nursing leader
  • Compare leadership styles

Midwifery / OBG Nursing I

Family Welfare & Contraception

  • Family welfare and contraception in India — goals, methods, counselling and the right of couples to choose.

Nursing Management & Leadership

Controlling & Quality Assurance

  • Control and quality assurance — standards, indicators, audit, incident reporting and stress management.
  • Describe the process of control
  • List quality assurance activities in nursing

Nursing Management & Leadership

Organisational Behaviour & Human Relations

  • Organisational behaviour and human relations — personality, perception, groups, communication, conflict and stress.
  • Describe organisational behaviour in nursing
  • Explain perception and personality in teams

Nursing Management & Leadership

Quality, Audit & Patient Safety

  • Quality, patient safety and risk management — pillars of quality care, accreditation, safety programmes and stress.
  • Describe the pillars of quality care
  • Explain accreditation and standards
